change_ref: example: pipeline validation, not a governance claim
expected_trace_observable: fraction of tool_calls with status=error declines after the change
metric_query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tool_calls tc JOIN runs r ON r.run_id=tc.run_id WHERE tc.status='error' AND r.started_at>=:since AND r.started_at<:until
control_query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tool_calls tc JOIN runs r ON r.run_id=tc.run_id WHERE tc.status='success' AND r.started_at>=:since AND r.started_at<:until
